Online examination form

Question: Design an online examination form using HTML and JavaScript.

View source code (HTML + JavaScript)
<form id="examForm" novalidate>
  <div class="row">
    <div><label for="sname">Student name</label><input id="sname" placeholder="Full name"></div>
    <div><label for="roll">Roll number</label><input id="roll" placeholder="e.g. 101"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="questions"></div>
  <button type="submit">Submit exam</button>
  <button type="reset" class="alt" id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
</form>
<div id="result" class="msg"></div>

<script>
const questions = [
  {q:"Which tag is used to include a JavaScript file?", o:["<link>","<script>","<js>","<code>"], a:1},
  {q:"Which method shows a message box with an OK button?", o:["alert()","prompt()","print()","log()"], a:0},
  {q:"Which symbol starts a single-line comment in JavaScript?", o:["<!-- -->","#","//","**"], a:2},
  {q:"Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable?", o:["var","let","int","dim"], a:1},
  {q:"What does typeof 42 return?", o:["string","number","integer","object"], a:1}
];
const box = document.getElementById("questions");
questions.forEach((item, i) => {
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  const h = document.createElement("label");
  h.textContent = (i + 1) + ". " + item.q;
  wrap.appendChild(h);
  item.o.forEach((text, j) => {
    const l = document.createElement("label");
    l.className = "inline";
    const r = document.createElement("input");
    r.type = "radio"; r.name = "q" + i; r.value = j;
    l.appendChild(r);
    l.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
    wrap.appendChild(l);
  });
  box.appendChild(wrap);
});
const result = document.getElementById("result");
function show(text, ok) { result.textContent = text; result.className = "msg show " + (ok ? "ok" : "err"); }
document.getElementById("examForm").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const name = document.getElementById("sname").value.trim();
  const roll = document.getElementById("roll").value.trim();
  if (name === "" || roll === "") { show("Please enter your name and roll number.", false); return; }
  let score = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < questions.length; i++) {
    const chosen = document.querySelector('input[name="q' + i + '"]:checked');
    if (!chosen) { show("Please answer question " + (i + 1) + ".", false); return; }
    if (Number(chosen.value) === questions[i].a) score++;
  }
  show(name + " (Roll " + roll + "): you scored " + score + " out of " + questions.length + " - " + (score >= 3 ? "Pass" : "Fail"), score >= 3);
});
document.getElementById("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => result.className = "msg");
</script>

  bad = setErr(5, $("dob").value === "" ? "Select your date of birth" : "") || bad;
  bad = setErr(6, $("country").value === "" ? "Select a country" : "") || bad;

    <div><label for="dept">Department</label>

    <div><label for="adate">Appointment date</label><input id="adate" type="date"></div>
  </div>
  <label>Gender</label>
  <label class="inline"><input type="radio" name="g" value="Male">Male</label>
  <label class="inline"><input type="radio" name="g" value="Female">Female</label>
  <label class="inline"><input type="radio" name="g" value="Other">Other</label>
  <label for="symptoms">Symptoms / reason for visit</label><textarea id="symptoms" rows="3"></textarea>
  <button type="submit">Register patient</button><button type="reset" class="alt">Reset</button>
</form>
<div id="msg" class="msg"></div>

<script>
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
$("adate").min = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
$("hForm").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const m = $("msg");
  const g = document.querySelector('input[name="g"]:checked');
  const age = Number($("age").value);
  let error = "";
  if ($("pname").value.trim() === "") error = "Patient name is required.";
  else if (!age || age < 0 || age > 120) error = "Enter a valid age (1-120).";
  else if (!g) error = "Select a gender.";
  else if (!/^[6-9][0-9]{9}$/.test($("phone").value)) error = "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.";
  else if ($("blood").value === "") error = "Select a blood group.";
  else if ($("dept").value === "") error = "Select a department.";
  else if ($("adate").value === "") error = "Select an appointment date.";
  if (error) { m.className = "msg show err"; m.textContent = error; return; }
  const id = "HSP" + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
  m.className = "msg show ok";
  m.textContent = "Registered! Patient ID: " + id + " | " + $("pname").value.trim() + ", " + age + " yrs | " + $("dept").value + " on " + $("adate").value;
});
</script>

<label for="seat">Enter seat number</label>
<input id="seat" placeholder="Try 1001, 1002, 1003 or 1004">
<button id="go">Show marksheet</button>
<div id="out"></div>

<script>
const students = {
  1001: {name:"Aarav Patil", marks:{"Client-Side Web Technologies":78,"Java Programming":82,"DBMS":69,"Python":74,"Mathematics":65}},
  1002: {name:"Sneha Kulkarni", marks:{"Client-Side Web Technologies":91,"Java Programming":88,"DBMS":85,"Python":90,"Mathematics":79}},
  1003: {name:"Rohan Deshmukh", marks:{"Client-Side Web Technologies":55,"Java Programming":48,"DBMS":62,"Python":51,"Mathematics":39}},
  1004: {name:"Priya Shah", marks:{"Client-Side Web Technologies":67,"Java Programming":72,"DBMS":70,"Python":64,"Mathematics":58}}
};
document.getElementById("go").addEventListener("click", function () {
  const out = document.getElementById("out");
  const seat = document.getElementById("seat").value.trim();
  const s = students[seat];
  if (!s) { out.innerHTML = '<div class="msg show err">No student found for seat number "' + seat.replace(/</g, "") + '".</div>'; return; }
  let rows = "", total = 0, pass = true;
  for (const subject in s.marks) {
    const m = s.marks[subject];
    total += m;
    if (m < 40) pass = false;
    rows += "<tr><td>" + subject + "</td><td>100</td><td>" + m + "</td><td>" + (m >= 40 ? "Pass" : "Fail") + "</td></tr>";
  }
  const max = Object.keys(s.marks).length * 100;
  const pct = (total / max * 100).toFixed(2);
  const grade = !pass ? "F" : pct >= 75 ? "A (Distinction)" : pct >= 60 ? "B (First Class)" : pct >= 50 ? "C (Second Class)" : "D (Pass)";
  out.innerHTML = "<h3>" + s.name + " — Seat No. " + seat + "</h3><table><tr><th>Subject</th><th>Max</th><th>Obtained</th><th>Status</th></tr>" + rows +
    "<tr><th>Total</th><th>" + max + "</th><th>" + total + "</th><th></th></tr></table><p><strong>Percentage:</strong> " + pct + "%   <strong>Result:</strong> " + (pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + "   <strong>Grade:</strong> " + grade + "</p>";
});
</script>

Client-Side Web Technologies · Lab assignment 9

Basic calculator

Question: Create a calculator using JavaScript to perform basic arithmetic operations.

View source code (HTML + JavaScript)
<div class="calc">
  <input id="display" value="0" readonly aria-label="Display">
  <div class="keys" id="keys"></div>
</div>

<script>
const display = document.getElementById("display");
let current = "0", previous = null, operator = null, fresh = true;
const layout = ["C","+/-","%","/","7","8","9","*","4","5","6","-","1","2","3","+","0",".","DEL","="];
const keys = document.getElementById("keys");
layout.forEach(k => {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = k;
  b.className = "/*-+=".includes(k) ? "op" : (/[0-9.]/.test(k) ? "num" : "alt");
  b.addEventListener("click", () => press(k));
  keys.appendChild(b);
});
function compute(a, b, op) {
  if (op === "+") return a + b;
  if (op === "-") return a - b;
  if (op === "*") return a * b;
  if (op === "/") return b === 0 ? "Error" : a / b;
  return b;
}
function press(k) {
  if (current === "Error") { current = "0"; fresh = true; }
  if (/[0-9]/.test(k)) { current = (fresh || current === "0") ? k : current + k; fresh = false; }
  else if (k === ".") { if (fresh) { current = "0."; fresh = false; } else if (!current.includes(".")) current += "."; }
  else if (k === "C") { current = "0"; previous = null; operator = null; fresh = true; }
  else if (k === "DEL") { current = current.length > 1 ? current.slice(0, -1) : "0"; }
  else if (k === "+/-") { current = String(-Number(current)); }
  else if (k === "%") { current = String(Number(current) / 100); }
  else if (k === "=") {
    if (operator !== null) { current = String(compute(previous, Number(current), operator)); previous = null; operator = null; fresh = true; }
  } else {
    if (operator !== null && !fresh) { current = String(compute(previous, Number(current), operator)); }
    previous = Number(current); operator = k; fresh = true;
  }
  if (current !== "Error" && current.length > 12) current = String(Number(current).toPrecision(10) / 1);
  display.value = current;
}
</script>

Question: Write a JavaScript program demonstrating the use of setInterval() and clearInterval().

<div class="big" id="counter">0</div>
<p id="clock"></p>
<button id="start">Start</button><button id="stop" class="alt">Stop (clearInterval)</button><button id="reset" class="alt">Reset</button>
<div id="msg" class="msg"></div>

<script>
let timer = null, count = 0;
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
function say(t) { $("msg").className = "msg show ok"; $("msg").textContent = t; }
$("start").onclick = function () {
  if (timer !== null) { say("Already running."); return; }
  timer = setInterval(function () {
    count++;
    $("counter").textContent = count;
    $("clock").textContent = "Tick at " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  }, 1000);
  say("setInterval started: runs every 1000 ms.");
};
$("stop").onclick = function () {
  clearInterval(timer);
  timer = null;
  say("clearInterval called: counter stopped at " + count + ".");
};
$("reset").onclick = function () { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; count = 0; $("counter").textContent = 0; $("clock").textContent = ""; say("Reset."); };
</script>

<div class="row">

  <div><label for="b">Second number</label><input id="b" type="number"></div>
</div>
<button onclick="calc('add')">Add</button><button onclick="calc('sub')" class="alt">Subtract</button>
<button onclick="calc('mul')" class="alt">Multiply</button><button onclick="calc('div')" class="alt">Divide</button>
<div id="out" class="msg"></div>

<script>
function addition(a, b) { return a + b; }
function subtraction(a, b) { return a - b; }
function multiplication(a, b) { return a * b; }
function division(a, b) { return a / b; }
function calc(op) {
  const sa = document.getElementById("a").value, sb = document.getElementById("b").value;
  const out = document.getElementById("out");
  if (sa === "" || sb === "") { out.className = "msg show err"; out.textContent = "Please enter both numbers."; return; }
  const a = Number(sa), b = Number(sb);
  let r, sym;
  if (op === "add") { r = addition(a, b); sym = "+"; }
  else if (op === "sub") { r = subtraction(a, b); sym = "-"; }
  else if (op === "mul") { r = multiplication(a, b); sym = "x"; }
  else {
    if (b === 0) { out.className = "msg show err"; out.textContent = "Cannot divide by zero."; return; }
    r = division(a, b); sym = "/";
  }
  out.className = "msg show ok";
  out.textContent = a + " " + sym + " " + b + " = " + r;
}
</script>

Replace letter m with a

Question: Write a JavaScript program to find all occurrences of the letter m in a user-entered string, replace them with a, and display the modified string on the page.

View source code (HTML + JavaScript)
<label for="txt">Enter a string</label>
<input id="txt" value="my mom makes marvelous mango milkshake">
<button id="go">Find and replace</button>
<div id="out"></div>

<script>
document.getElementById("go").addEventListener("click", function () {
  const s = document.getElementById("txt").value;
  const out = document.getElementById("out");
  if (s === "") { out.innerHTML = '<div class="msg show err">Please enter a string.</div>'; return; }
  let count = 0, positions = [], result = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    if (s[i] === "m" || s[i] === "M") {      // find every m (either case)
      count++;
      positions.push(i);
      result += s[i] === "m" ? "a" : "A";    // replace with a
    } else {
      result += s[i];
    }
  }
  const p = document.createElement("div");
  p.className = "msg show ok";
  p.innerHTML = "<strong>Original:</strong> <span id=o></span><br><strong>Occurrences of m:</strong> " + count +
    (count ? " (at index " + positions.join(", ") + ")" : "") + "<br><strong>Modified:</strong> <span id=r></span>";
  out.innerHTML = ""; out.appendChild(p);
  document.getElementById("o").textContent = s;
  document.getElementById("r").textContent = result;
});
</script>
